Plans & itineraries

Half-day route at Pantai Carocok

Many visitors have only half a day. This page arranges a sensible route without promising exact travel figures.

Updated · 28 Oktober 2026

Order

Bay edge first

Start at the beach edge for photos and walking, then a short rest, then back to central Painan for food.

  • 0–60 min: walk and photo the bay edge.
  • 60–90 min: rest or snack.
  • 90–120 min: eat in central Painan.

Add island

Cingkuak option

If the crossing is available, add time for Cingkuak Island. Do not lock the schedule because of weather.

Flexible

Use the land plan as a base; add water activities only if staff say it is safe.

Backup

If weather is bad

Midday heat or rain: use land activities and stalls for shelter.

Questions

Before you go

01Is 3 hours at Carocok enough?+

Yes, 60–120 minutes at the beach plus eating in Painan is enough for a short visit.

02Can I also visit the island?+

If the crossing is available, add time. Do not lock the schedule because of weather.

03When is the best time?+

Morning or late afternoon give better light and less heat.

04If it rains?+

Use land activities and stalls for shelter.
